title: BioIVT: DIN is text up to 15 characters, nothing else restricted
description: Gives every DIN question (DIN and Follow-up DIN, both studies) the same rule: text, at most 15 characters, no pattern. 15 is the longest DIN in the real Carlsbad data (for example 002-6504-660002); digits and hyphens are what occur there.
rationale: Dan's decision: the longest existing DIN and the least restrictive type, applied to every DIN field. Detroit DIN lengths were not available.

set.field.constraint_message: A DIN can be at most 15 characters.

source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
